content: निवेशनम् .²1 Entering, entrance. .²2 Halting, encamping. .²3 Marrying, marriage; प्रतिलोमनिवेशनम् <ls>Bhāg. 3. 7. 31</ls>. .²4 Entering in writing, inscribing. .²5 An abode, a dwelling, house, habitation. .²6 A camp; निवेशयामास मुदा कल्पितान्यनिवेशने <ls>Bhāg. 10. 53. 16</ls>; <ls>Mb. 3. 240. 1</ls>. .²7 A town or city; पार्थिवस्य निवेशने <ls>Rām. 7. 62. 18</ls>. .²8 A nest. .{@-नी@} The earth.
